name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aerodynamics, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in fluid dynamics, and secured an internship at a smaller racing outfit before landing his role at CRG Racing. Rhys is meticulous in his approach to wind tunnel testing, believing in the power of detailed data analysis to unlock subtle improvements in aerodynamic performance. His dedication and innovative ideas, often stemming from his unconventional thinking, have made him a valuable asset to the team, always striving to find that extra edge. He sees his role as a crucial component to the overall success of the team, and always keeps an eye on the progress made throughout the season.

Since joining CRG, Rhys has been instrumental in refining several aerodynamic packages, contributing directly to improved lap times. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and often proposes radical adjustments based on his interpretations of the data. He is particularly skilled at identifying areas where subtle changes can yield significant gains, and is a key member when it comes to troubleshooting issues that may arise during the racing season.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing glasses to protect his eyes during wind tunnel testing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas during wind tunnel runs.
Has a habit of humming quietly while analyzing data.
Refuses to eat lunch at his desk, always taking a break outside, regardless of the weather.
